title: sacdj's RPDND Modpack
description: Modpack made to play on the RPDND POTP server
body:
# This is my modpack i use for the RPDND server it comes with:

a minimap,

a mod for copying chat.

Keybinds for switching chat and opening the crafting menu,

A utility mod to help not break certain blocks and click the scrap piles

aswell as remove certain things from rendering.

It also comes with DH for more chunks.

U can also move around while ur loading in to the server so the loading screen is not as annoying

there is also a gamma mod with nightvision u can toggle and change the strength of 

**Note: nightvision is broken with iris/lamb dynmaic lights, Maybe astroid i dunno otherwise use the module in astroid. If u are using modrinth launcher u can disable them individually**




<details>
<summary>Most Controls</summary>

Astroid:
- Right Shift = Module menu
-  ´ = No Render
-  ¨ = No Interact (Block breaking)
-  ' = Autoclicker (Scrap piles)
-  , = Fullbright (uses block light at light level 6)

Chat Tools binds:
- INS = Crafting Menu

Use CTRL for these next ones:
- END = Global chat
- DEL = Local chat
- HOME = /spawn

</details>
